actions.body: The WAKE architecture relies on a strict separation between untrusted proposal inputs and deterministic state updates. Governance acts as the mechanical gatekeeper, ensuring that every transition is authorized by the record, not the proposer. By using an append-only SQLite container for the durable record, the system guarantees that history is reconstructible and immutable. These findings confirm that accountability is derived from the enforcement of mechanical rules over the state-update sequence, rather than persistent selfhood in the model invocations themselves.
actions.lede: WAKE achieves process continuity by decoupling proposals from state transitions through a hardened kernel boundary.
actions.reason: Synthesizing research into WAKE's continuity and accountability mechanisms.
actions.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms
